reviews.title: Get Adobe Scan
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for years as a fast and easy way to scan and send documents as pdf and have had no issues. 

Now they want to charge you to scan more than 1 page which is ridiculous and warrants uninstall as the app is now unusable. Use adobe scan instead

reviews.text: I signed up for this back in May and used it once. I did not realize I have been getting charged weekly, not monthly but weekly 4.99 for this app! I wish I had noticed sooner.
